{{Quote|You will find others like you in the Rebellion. Join them, my student.|Jhor-Kai|<ref name="CoL" />}}
'''Jhor-Kai''' was an elderly [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. He lived to an old age, surviving on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Altikar IV]], and eventually called through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to a young [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] girl, [[Sha'lia]], asking her to be his apprentice. Though a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] at this time, she escaped from her owner and joined Jhor-Kai on Altikar IV. Jhor-Kai began training her in the Force until he was discovered and [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]; during this [[Skirmish on Altikar IV|skirmish]], Jhor-Kai sacrificed his life so that that Sha'lia might escape.

==Biography==
Jhor-Kai was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], he lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Altikar IV]], and began appearing in the dreams of a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] dancer named [[Sha'lia]], inviting her to join him on the planet. The girl eventually escaped from [[Toleen Bisma|her owner]] with the aid of a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] named [[Goort]], and she and Goort traveled to Altikar IV. There, Jhor-Kai opened Sha'lia to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], an overwhelming experience for the Twi'lek, and began to teach her about the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light]] and [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark sides]] of the Force, and how to manipulate and use the Force. He also taught Goort the basics of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]], aided by his own knowledge of the [[Dosh/Legends|Dosh]] language.<ref name="CoL" />

One day while training Sha'lia, [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces arrived on Altikar IV and [[Skirmish on Altikar IV|attacked]] Jhor-Kai in his training area. Jhor-Kai held the Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] at bay with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], buying time for his pupil to escape. His parting words to Sha'lia, before being [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the Imperials, were to seek out the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] where she could find other [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]].<ref name="CoL" />

===Legacy===
Jhor-Kai later appeared in a vision experienced by Goort. While inside the [[Temple of Pain]], a [[Sith temple/Legends|Sith Temple]] located inside an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] in the [[Tascollan Nebula/Legends|Tascollan Nebula]], Goort entered the [[Room of Dreams]], a place where the dark side of the Force caused all who entered it to have visions that would bring them closer to giving in to its seductive powers. The vision Goort experienced was about Jhor-Kai's death, and Goort saw the old man falling after being hit by [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire from some stormtroopers. In the vision, with some of his last words, Jhor-Kai told Goort to protect Sha'lia and ensure that nothing adverse happened to her. He then screamed and told Goort and Sha'lia to leave quickly.<ref name="Light and Dark">"[[Light and Dark (adventure)|Light and Dark]]"</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Jhor-Kai was keen to teach others, inviting Sha'lia to Altikar IV to train her in the Force. He was also proficient in piloting starships, and was comfortable teaching this skill to Goort. Jhor-Kai was selfless enough to die in order to buy time for Sha'lia and Goort to escape the Imperial presence.<ref name="CoL" />

==Powers and abilities==
Jhor-Kai was skilled enough in the Force to appear across the galaxy in a vision to his chosen apprentice Sha'lia. He was knowledgeable about the Jedi and the Force, and was skilled with a lightsaber.<ref name="CoL" /> Despite this, in later years, Sha'lia was unsure whether Jhor-Kai was actually a Jedi, or merely claimed to be one.<ref name="Light and Dark" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jhor-Kai was created by [[Lee Pickler]] for the ''[[Child of Light saga]]'', a series of three [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|roleplaying]] adventures for the [[Wizards of the Coast]] [[RPGA]]. Jhor-Kai himself never appeared in any of the adventures but formed part of the backstory of two player characters, Sha'lia and Goort. All the information given about Jhor-Kai is from the perspective of either Sha'lia or Goort. While there is some doubt in Sha'lia's mind as to whether Jhor-Kai was a Jedi, all other evidence points to Jhor-Kai being a Jedi.
